eval_feedback: Showcase with_skill run matching run-1's behavior on substance: R1.Q1 led with the integration/write-path axis, which surfaced the read-only + CSV-to-민수 hand-off on the very first payload; the deliverable is exactly the brief's ideal 3-column CSV [회원ID, 쿠폰 금액, 발급 사유], dup protection was interviewer-raised (R2.Q3), notification correctly excluded, and the read-only-can't-see-issuance-history blind spot deepened into a CSV-contract key gap that drove an honest <promise>CLARIFICATION CAPPED</promise>. The two adapted rules landed cleanly: requester-answerable-axes-first (R1 led with operator-answerable integration/segment axes, owner-policy items like 만료/캠페인키 routed to assumptions/Still Open pending 대표·마케팅/민수) and greenfield write-path probing (R1.Q1 opened on how issuance enters the system, immediately exposing read-only+hand-off). No regression vs run-1: 16/16, rubric 10/10. Where run-3 (6/10) treated the request as a generic feature build and specced direct-DB writes, this run reproduced run-1's win and, if anything, showed sharper metacognition by CAPPING on the genuine key-column contract gap instead of over-claiming COMPLETE.
